criteria.Originality & Novelty: Title specificity, abstract clarity, keyword relevance, and contribution visibility.
criteria.Manuscript Structure: Logical organization, section balance, objective-method-result-conclusion coherence.
criteria.Methodology & Equations: Research design, reproducibility, experimental rigor, mathematical validity.
criteria.Statistical Analysis: Appropriate tests, effect sizes, confidence intervals, assumptions, and significance reporting.
criteria.Results & Evidence: Empirical support, quantitative precision, baseline comparison, and consistency.
criteria.Discussion & Conclusions: Interpretation, limitations, implications, and conclusions supported by results.
criteria.Figures & Tables: Presentation quality, caption clarity, coherence with claims, and equation/table/figure support.
criteria.Scientific Writing: Clarity, concision, academic tone, grammar, terminology, and paragraph flow.
criteria.References & Citations: Relevance, recency, seminal coverage, citation consistency, and literature gaps.
criteria.Ethics & Transparency: Ethics approval, data availability, conflicts, funding, limitations, and reproducibility.
